description: Off-USDA copy of the FoodData Central bulk archives the base-food search depends on (ADR-0045). SR Legacy is discontinued and its final release was 2018-04, so upstream availability is insured rather than assumed.
counts_note: records counts the real food records and null_entries the empty slots beside them; both are measured from the archive by `usda:backup verify`, not restated by hand.

archives.note: The base record of every merged search hit. Carries foodPortions. Its array holds 395 entries, the last 32 of which are literally null, so the array length is not the record count.
Frozen and discontinued: the fill source for ADR-0045 section 2 and the only copy of most base foods. The one archive that cannot be re-created if it disappears.
Not used by search. Kept for its household portions, the named follow-up if portions ever need widening (research note 108).
